entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A dragon planeswalker who seeks to gather Alara's mana into the Maelstrom; the only planeswalker who knows of it.

entities.name: The Maelstrom
entities.description: A savage storm of raw mana at the center of Alara where the five shards overlap, growing ever more dangerous.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane of five reconverged shards, torn by war.

entities.name: Mana
entities.description: The most generative force in the Multiverse, raw potential that mages shape into spells.

entities.name: Cylian elves
entities.description: Elves of Naya who have only stories of pre-Sundering Alara.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard of Alara home to the Cylian elves.

events.summary: Since the shards reconverged, the Maelstrom has grown from a tiny seed to a raging tempest feeding on the Alaran war.
events.quote: Since the shards reconverged, the Maelstrom has grown from a tiny seed to a raging tempest of potential

events.summary: Nicol Bolas leaves the Maelstrom unguarded because it destroys or scares off interlopers on its own.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas has set up no guardians of the Maelstrom.

events.summary: Alarans are only now discovering the Maelstrom; no planeswalker but Bolas knows of it.
events.quote: not even a planeswalker (other than Bolas) knows of its existence yet

relations.note: Seeks to gather Alara's mana into it for his plans.
relations.quote: The dragon Nicol Bolas seeks to gather the mana resources of the combined shards of Alara into a single tremendous source
The Maelstrom lies at the center of Alara
